security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally directs the assistant to use the eightctl CLI for Eight Sleep pod operations, including temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, and base controls. Static findings for Markdown command examples are partly valid because they describe external command use, while the system reconnaissance and homepage URL findings are false positives. No prompt injection attempt was found, but the install metadata uses a mutable Go module target.

remediation.issue: The install metadata uses a mutable Go module target.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the eightctl Go module to a reviewed version instead of using the latest target.

remediation.issue: The skill references credential-based authentication through config files and environment variables.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to avoid exposing passwords in shell history, logs, shared terminals, or process listings.

remediation.issue: The skill can change connected sleep device state.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the existing confirmation requirement before temperature, alarm, schedule, audio, or base changes.

content.user_title: Control Eight Sleep Pods with CLI Commands
content.value_statement: Eight Sleep users need quick access to pod status and common controls without switching tools. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through eightctl commands for safe device management.
actual_capabilities: Checks Eight Sleep pod status through the eightctl CLI.
Turns the pod on or off with user confirmation.
Sets pod temperature values through eightctl.
Lists, creates, and updates sleep schedules.
Controls supported audio and base functions.
limitations: Requires the eightctl binary to be installed.
Requires valid Eight Sleep authentication through config or environment variables.
Uses an unofficial API that may be rate-limited or change.
Should confirm before changing temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, or base angle.

use_cases.title: Check Bed Status
use_cases.description: Review current pod state before making temperature or power changes.

use_cases.title: Adjust Night Settings
use_cases.description: Set pod temperature, alarms, and schedules from an assistant workflow.

use_cases.title: Debug Pod Setup
use_cases.description: Verify authentication, command availability, and API limits during setup.

prompt_templates.title: Check Pod Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Eight Sleep pod status with eightctl and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Set Pod Temperature
prompt_templates.prompt: Set my Eight Sleep pod temperature to 20 after confirming the change with me.

prompt_templates.title: Review Alarms
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Eight Sleep alarms and tell me which ones are active.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Sleep Schedule
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Eight Sleep schedule, identify tomorrow's settings, and ask before making any updates.

output_examples.output: Your pod is reachable, powered on, and reporting current settings. No change was made.
I will confirm first because this changes your device temperature. After approval, I will apply the requested setting.
I found your configured alarms and summarized their active days, times, and current state.

best_practices: Confirm every command that changes pod state.
Use a dedicated eightctl config file with protected file permissions.
Avoid repeated login attempts because the API is unofficial and rate-limited.
anti_patterns: Do not expose Eight Sleep passwords in chat, logs, or shell history.
Do not run schedule or alarm changes without user approval.
Do not retry failing API commands in tight loops.

faq.question: What does this skill control?
faq.answer: It controls supported Eight Sleep pod functions through the eightctl CLI.

faq.question: Does it install eightctl automatically?
faq.answer: The skill metadata declares a Go install option, but the binary must be available before use.

faq.question: What authentication is needed?
faq.answer: eightctl needs valid Eight Sleep credentials through its config file or supported environment variables.

faq.question: Can it change my bed temperature?
faq.answer: Yes. It should ask for confirmation before applying any temperature change.

faq.question: Does it use an official Eight Sleep API?
faq.answer: No. The skill notes that the API is unofficial and rate-limited.

faq.question: Can it manage alarms and schedules?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide listing, creating, updating, and dismissing supported alarms and schedules.
